csv_row.description: Analyze French rental property investments with comprehensive financial modeling. Use when analyzing French properties, calculating mortgage payments, ROI, cash flow projections, or break-even analysis. Includes French-specific costs like arrangement fees (1%), registration fees (1.5%), survey fees (€750), and mandatory life insurance (0.4% annually).
